{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
df_qa = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(df_qa)}')

# Since the population is ALL rows in sales.csv, we must include QA orders and refunded orders
# But we must still parse revenue correctly
# Now compute conversion rate by segment using the full dataset
# Conversion rate = proportion of converted orders in each segment

# Group by customer_segment and compute mean of 'converted'
df_conv = df.groupby('customer_segment', as_index=False)['converted'].mean()
df_conv = df_conv.sort_values('converted', ascending=False)
print(f'Conversion rates by segment (using all rows):\n{df_conv}')

# Return the top segment
top_segment = df_conv.iloc[0]['customer_segment']
print(f'Top segment: {top_segment}')"}
